title: Tumbler Toothbrush Holder Wall Mount Solid Brass 4.5-Inch | Unlacquered Brass | Brass Toothbrush Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Keep everyday brushing essentials organized and off the vanity with a wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder designed for a clean, finished look in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Clean, finished appearance—concealed screw mounting hardware hides fasteners
- Coordinate your bathroom look—part of the Brass Toothbrush Holders collection and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Wall mounted tumbler and toothbrush holder
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Concealed screw wall-mount hardware included
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 4.7 x 3.5 in.
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.
